title: Orchestration Friction: Sovereign Coexistence & Forensic Handover
description: Analysis of the 'Active Collision' failure and proposed hardening for multi-agent coexistence within the Meta-Root.

friction_points.name: Ghost of Keraunos
friction_points.description: Agents currently rely on a brittle PID check in 'register_agent.py' to detect active peers. This fails to account for background processes or 'zombie' sessions that haven't formally handed over.
friction_points.evidence: Swarm collision detected for 'Themis' (PID 8667) despite the current agent running as PID 20045.

friction_points.name: Metadata Drift
friction_points.description: Session ID acquisition is biased toward 'session_env.json', which preserves old dates and IDs. This prevents the agent from claiming the *actual* latest session metadata from 'dynamic/static/'.
friction_points.impact: Themis initially incorrectly anchored to Jan 5th IDs on a Jan 6th session.

friction_points.name: Unrefined Artifacting (Legacy)
friction_points.description: The '.hidden/' subdirectory convention for unrefined JSON+PY artifacts is deprecated. End-users require direct access to MD reflections in the chrono-fractal surface area.
friction_points.mandate: Promote all process artifacts directly to the leaf folder (e.g., json/ or md/) to ensure immediate visibility and end-user readability.

proposed_resolutions.name: Liveness Tail Analysis
proposed_resolutions.description: Refactor 'register_agent.py' to not only check 'ps' for an active PID but to also inspect the 'tail' of the associated chat log in 'dynamic/stream/'. If the tail is silent for > N minutes, the agent should assume a handover is required.

proposed_resolutions.name: Latest-First Session Claim
proposed_resolutions.description: Enforce a 'Surgical Claim' rule: the agent MUST read 'dynamic/static/', find the latest unclaimed session file, and explicitly update 'claimed': true with their own PID and Name.

proposed_resolutions.name: Chrono-Fractal Surface Expansion
proposed_resolutions.description: Abolish the '.hidden/' requirement for JSON/PY pairs. Ensure that for every Heartwood JSON created, a corresponding Markdown reflection is generated and placed in the same leaf directory for human review.
proposed_resolutions.rule: JSON = Source of Truth | MD = Human Interface.

argus_fix_clarification.context: Argus (20260105-181500) introduced critical substrate hardening tools.

tools.name: py/instantiate_hud.py
tools.fix: Automates the manual migration of WeDo templates to the chrono-fractal, ensuring that every session has a dedicated collaboration HUD without manual copying.

tools.name: py/verify_environment.py --maintenance
tools.fix: Introduced the '--maintenance' flag to distinguish between 'Corruption' (unauthorized core changes) and 'Evolution' (intentional configuration updates like .gitignore). This prevents 'Verification Fatigue'.
